result.title: Spectra: Exact Component Transport for Test-Time Prior Adaptation in Simulation-Based Inference
result.summary: Simulation-based inference (SBI) has become a powerful approach to Bayesian inference in complex scientific models whose likelihoods are difficult or impossible to evaluate. Amortized SBI learns reusable inference models from simulated data, enabling rapid posterior inference for new observations, and modern generative models have made these models increasingly expressive. However, this reuse is limited to the prior distribution chosen during training, whereas scientific analyses often need revised priors as knowledge accumulates or alternative assumptions are tested. We introduce Spectra, a test-time adaptation method for diffusion-based SBI. Spectra uses an exact score-transport identity to obtain the adapted score from a frozen diffusion model in closed form for structured prior changes, without additional simulation or training. Across six SBI benchmarks, Spectra achieves accurate adaptation under strong prior shifts at low online sampling cost. This enables pretrained SBI models to incorporate updated prior information at test time.

AI.brief_summary: Spectra 提出一种面向扩散式模拟推断（SBI）的测试时先验适配方法，利用精确的 score 传输恒等式，在冻结扩散模型上以闭式解获得适配后的 score，无需额外模拟或训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作的「冻结生成模型上闭式改造 score 分布以适配新条件」这一思路，可能与 LVR 中在推理期无训练地修正 latent 状态/引导分布、或按新证据调整生成轨迹的问题形成类比线索，但属远领域，需核查其结构化变换假设是否可迁移到多模态推理状态。
